blockers.description: Agent CANNOT merge these PRs. gh pr merge --admin is denied by the Claude Code auto-mode classifier, and --admin exists to bypass branch protection, so working around the denial defeats its intent
blockers.workaround: Operator runs the merge commands with a ! prefix. Do not substitute an API call that achieves the same mutation.

blockers.description: A human review is required regardless of permissions: #25 reports reviewDecision REVIEW_REQUIRED, the PRs are authored under the operator identity, and GitHub blocks self-approval
blockers.workaround: No permission grant removes the human from this loop.

blockers.description: Wrong gh account active. The merge failed with: bcurry-arrow does not have the correct permissions to execute MergePullRequest. thezoid has admin:true on the repo. A gh auth switch to thezoid was performed and REVERTED on its own (hosts.yml reads user: bcurry-arrow again)
blockers.workaround: Run gh auth status and re-switch immediately before merging; do not assume it stuck.

blockers.description: No PR in this set can go green alone: each reds on a CVE another PR owns. All are MERGEABLE with no conflicts; it is the ruleset requiring green checks
blockers.workaround: First merge needs --admin; the rest cascade green. Alternative: fold the cryptography pin into #24 so it goes green unaided (reverses an explicit operator decision, so not done unilaterally).

blockers.description: Independent verify (A) needs cosign + gh with read:packages on lintool03, not the Windows dev box: UAT-5 requires a LAN-pulled image and Docker is not installed locally
blockers.workaround: gh auth login -h github.com -s read:packages -w. A bare gh auth refresh WITHOUT -s is a silent no-op that prints success AND can flip the active account.

blockers.description: Harden-runner block-flip (B) needs a GREEN ci.yml run Step-Security insights; the only URL on file is the release path, the wrong workflow. Six call sites, not five
blockers.workaround: Land the merges first. Never guess the allowlist.

decisions.decision: Halted /gsd-autonomous at the blocker gate instead of running discuss/plan/execute on Phases 20/22
decisions.rationale: Both are status:human_needed with context already gathered, so the workflow would have gone straight to plan->execute and written plans/summaries for work no agent can perform. Recorded anti-pattern.

decisions.decision: Track D (the Trivy fix) is the only agent-executable work left in v1.4, and it is a prerequisite for Track B, not a side quest
decisions.rationale: A block-flip cannot be validated against a red baseline

decisions.decision: Fixed the CVEs by upgrade in two places rather than one
decisions.rationale: The SARIF shows two distinct targets: cryptography lives in app/.venv (lockfile-reachable), setuptools+msgpack live in the base image's system site-packages (only reachable from the Dockerfile). A lockfile bump alone cannot clear the latter two.

decisions.decision: setuptools pinned >=83.0.0 rather than the 78.1.1 gate minimum
decisions.rationale: Clears CVE-2026-59890 (MEDIUM) in the same move so the SARIF stays quiet. Zero risk: the app runs from /app/.venv and never uses system setuptools.

decisions.decision: Did NOT repin the python:3.12-slim base digest
decisions.rationale: Checked the registry: the latest 3.12-slim index (sha256:57cd7c3a...) carries the same PYTHON_VERSION 3.12.13 as the current pin and declares no setuptools version, so a repin would not predictably clear the finding. Explicit upgrade is the targeted lever.

decisions.decision: Held .planning/STATE.md out of the Track D commit
decisions.rationale: Unrelated doc sync from the resume; keeps the PR diff to the three files CI actually cares about
Phase 22 live UAT is the capstone acceptance gate
